'''2011 Bespin Regionals Cooleo DS Yavin 4''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cooleo]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Poop Flops
* '''Username:''' Cooleo1c
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
